analogy.rationale: PARs are G protein-coupled receptors that are activated by proteases; most of these cell lines express little to no PARs, so PAR inhibitors should produce minimal transcriptional response, similar to other GPCR antagonists with low target expression. Other receptor antagonist classes are included as weak analogs because they also act on GPCRs that may be poorly expressed in these cells.
